question.prompt: Calculate \((-8)+5\) and \((-3)+(-4)\). (Give the answers in order, separated by commas.)

solutions.explanation: To add two numbers with opposite signs, use the sign of the number with the greater absolute value, then subtract the smaller absolute value from the greater one: \(-(8-5)=-3\). To add two numbers with the same sign, keep that sign and add their absolute values: \(-(3+4)=-7\).
solutions.title: Apply the signed addition rules
